slides.text: A battery quote that doesn't ask when you use power is just a guess.
Your bill shows you how much power you use each month.
slides.sub: It doesn't show your daily usage pattern, and that's what matters for a battery.
Size it without knowing your after-5pm use and you're guessing: too small and you still buy at night, too big and you paid for storage you never fill.
